title: Barbell Row
summary: Bent-over barbell row: upper back 1, lats 0.8, with the lower back holding the hinge (0.5). Heavy and loadable; also fatiguing.

muscles.why: Rhomboids and mid traps squeeze the shoulder blades.
The lats pull the upper arm back.
Rear delts help pull the arm back.
The elbow flexors bend the elbow.
Lower back holds the hinge the whole set (isometric).

setup.text: Hinge to about 30-45 degrees above parallel.
Overhand grip just outside the knees.
Brace and keep the back flat.

form_cues.cue: Pull the bar to your lower ribs
form_cues.why: Torso angle fixed through the set.
Lowering to straight arms each rep.
Swinging turns the row into a hip extension.

bias_tweaks.effect: More biceps and lats; more upright torso.

bias_tweaks.change: Lower in 2-3 seconds and pause briefly in the stretch
bias_tweaks.effect: Keeps tension on in the lengthened position and removes bounce, so each rep starts honestly.
bias_tweaks.caveat: Rep speeds from 0.5 to 8 s gave similar growth; this is a control tool, not a growth trick.

mistakes.text: Standing more upright each rep as you tire.
mistakes.fix: Lighten the load until the torso angle stays fixed.

mistakes.text: Standing up as the set goes on.

misconceptions.reality: Lighter rows taken close to failure grow muscle too.

misconceptions.myth: Every set has to go to failure to grow.
misconceptions.reality: Stopping a few reps short gave similar growth to failure in a meta-analysis; growth tends to rise as sets get closer to failure, but the exact curve is uncertain.

lower_risk.text: Ramp up before your first working set. For primary lifts the app suggests 50% x 8, 70% x 4 and 85% x 2 when the first working load is 60 kg or more, and 50% x 8 then 75% x 3 below that.
lower_risk.note: High-load warm-ups improved strength performance in a systematic review; the percentages are coaching convention.

lower_risk.text: Add load in small steps. The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first, up to 2 past the top of the range. Default steps for this equipment are 2.5 kg or 5 lb; your gym profile can replace them.
Aim for about 3 reps in reserve in the 6-10 rep range. Keep sets a few reps short of failure; your lower back fatigues too.
Pick a variation, range and setup you can train pain-free.

alternatives.why: Chest on a pad: no lower-back work.
One arm at a time with a bench for support.

alternatives.goal_label: Home gym: no equipment / bar only

notes: Row variations have not been compared for growth in a study the app cites.
Ratings and display bands are the library model (main >= 0.75, helper 0.4 to < 0.75, minor 0.25 to < 0.4, not counted < 0.25).
Technique and load management only. This page makes no medical or injury claims.
